rule: Response-side and model properties whose schema is a $ref to an object (message) definition are generated as nullable with a null default, because the gateway serialises unset proto3 sub-messages as null. Scalars, arrays and enums keep swagger `required`. Request bodies (T*Body) are unchanged.

allowlist.reason: Activity envelope: every submit/get_activity/approve/reject response is v1ActivityResponse, whose only field is the activity itself; a response without it is a protocol error.
T*Response for activity endpoints is constructed by the generated client from v1ActivityResponse.activity (allowlisted above); it is never decoded from JSON.
Constructed by the generated client from activity.result.<key>; the client throws ZeroXKeyHttpError.ActivityNotCompleted when the result is absent, so it is never null.
Variant property of a oneOf sealed type; the variant is selected only when this property is present and non-null.
